snippet.title: Witches' Grove Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Under the full moon, the Grove's fighters brawl through a game-show-like tournament where the winner will be granted their wish.

Witches' Grove is a pixel-art autobattler roguelite. You sponsor one fighter, your mentee, and spend gems in the market on potions, tickets, techniques and charms to shape their build. Then watch them battle it out in chaotic 4-way free-for-alls while the witch casts random spells on the ring.

It's easy to pick up, with plenty of depth underneath.

✦ Sponsor one mentee and build them your way
✦ 4-way free-for-all rounds, Grove Games and surprise bombshells
✦ Short Rumpus (~10 min) or Grand Rumpus (~15 min) runs
✦ A narrative arc for every fighter
✦ English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese

Launching December 11, 2026 on Steam.
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593060
